fact_dispositions.prior_value: A ground-resource management translation unit centered on a fixed array of four `UnkArchiveStruct` records. fact_dispositions.prior_value: The module maintains a four-slot archive registry. Initialization clears every slot; loading acquires the first record whose archive pointer is null and marks it occupied by assigning an archive pointer; exhausting all four slots asserts. Loaded `map_head` entries receive a monotonic `0x04000000` flag, while a missing external DAT selects static fallback stage data instead of an allocated archive.
